ranking_rule: expected value = plausibility x ceiling x feasibility / cost

standing_constraints.exploration_partition: E0/E1 read seasons 2021-2024 only; 2025-2026 is the confirmation holdout (GRAPH_POLICY 13.2, D062)
standing_constraints.manifest_gap: 68 shared artifacts have no manifest, including data/shotcharts/, data/playbyplay/, data/possessions/, data/lineups/, data/injury_history/, data/reference/player_bios.csv
standing_constraints.retrospective_artifact_in_tree: data/lineups/lineups_*.parquet are season-aggregate totals retrieved 2026-08-06 and are a T1 violation for any exploration-season use
standing_constraints.metric_convention: plain unweighted OLS R2, unweighted in fit, SSE and SST (D069, D072 ruling 2)

entries.statement: Measurement regime (`era`) is confounded with the exploration/holdout partition
entries.mechanism: 2021-2024 is ~92% gamelog_old; 2025-2026 is 100% gamelog_new with zero gamelog_old rows. Discovery and confirmation run on different measurement regimes and the boundary IS the partition boundary, so an E2 non-replication would be uninterpretable.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified on bytes: era x season cross-tab 2021 3565/320, 2022 4096/423, 2023 4544/354, 2024 4515/399, 2025 0/5853, 2026 0/4259. Third era value v3=5384 = exactly the DNP rows (minutes_source='none').
entries.trap_check: T4 promoted to partition level. T5: decide per column on values, never on names. T2 applies only if a skill claim is made; this is a measurement claim.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Not a dR2. A validity ceiling on every E2 the program will ever run.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Nothing in D001-D093 mentions `era`. D062 defined the partition and D063 designed the E2 ladder; neither checked for a source boundary.

entries.statement: Sweep every champion output for degeneracy, not just the cold-start region
entries.mechanism: A forecast that is constant, clipped, saturated or duplicated is a fallback, not a forecast, and pooled MAE/dR2 absorb it silently. The cold-start constant was invisible for the program's whole life until someone read the emitted values.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only, no fitting, coordinator-scoped. Forecast columns inventoried at D076/D088 (pts__pred_point, minutes, FGA, p_active).
entries.provenance_note: Scored frames exist in E0_I0015 and E0_I0019.
entries.trap_check: T8: report skill against a reference facing the same rows, never raw MAE. T6: a degeneracy check must be able to fire - validate on synthetic constant output.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: The one known instance (constant 8.704 pts, sd 0.013) was worth +1.36% pooled points skill on 7.2% of rows, free.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D092 closed the cold-start region only. D076 screened where skill is LOW; this screens the emitted VALUE distribution, which has never been audited.

entries.statement: Build one canonical reference ladder and re-price every recorded lead
entries.mechanism: dR2 and skill are relative statistics. With per-screen reference choice, ~1000 recorded cells are not on a common scale and a lead can be manufactured or destroyed by a defensible choice. D093 ranks reference dependence as the #1 explanation for the program's nulls.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only on existing frames. D093 showed which reference is strongest CHANGES with the filter (mean-of-prior-ratios wins at floor 0; ratio-of-prior-sums from floor 10 up).
entries.provenance_note: Uses already-manifested masters plus frozen screen frames.
entries.trap_check: T4 is the subject. T7: report the spread not a point estimate. D072 r4: dR2 is not scale-free across screens, so the ladder must fix the target too.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Re-prices the whole ledger. Two known instances moved the same result by 6.5x (D090: +46.4% vs +7.1%) and 4.6x (D093: +0.22% vs +4.24%).
entries.why_not_already_dead: D069 adopted a convention but ruled past numbers cannot be rescaled and must be RE-RUN. Nobody re-ran them. D072 identified the limit and stopped.
entries.gated_by: Must consume rather than duplicate E1_I0022_optimal_simple_estimator

entries.statement: Measure the program's detection floor before screening anything else
entries.mechanism: Nobody has computed the minimum detectable effect at n=18,216 played rows / 265 players / 966 team-games under the program's own null machinery. If the floor exceeds the ceilings being chased, the nulls are uninformative.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Pure simulation on the real design matrix. Inject synthetic signal at known dR2 (1e-4..1e-2) built as .shift(1).expanding() so it carries realistic autocorrelation; run the real pipeline incl. cyclic null and family-wise correction; report power curves.
entries.trap_check: T3: the injected regressor must carry realistic serial structure or the power estimate is wrong in the same direction the program was already wrong. T2: null at the candidate's own level.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Determines whether ~1000 recorded nulls are findings or power failures. Program's best lead is dR2 +0.0023; killing ceilings were 0.001127 and 0.000129.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never attempted. D093's single-player ceiling addresses per-player fitting, not the pooled screening design. D093 ranks sample size #3 among reasons the nulls may be artefacts.

entries.statement: The free-throw and foul-draw channel - the largest untested points surface
entries.mechanism: FT is a different process from field goals: volume from drawing fouls (unstable opportunity), conversion a stable player trait. That is exactly the opportunity x conversion decomposition T1/D060 calls for, and it is the one never tested. The two FG channels died on CEILINGS, not statistics, and this channel's ceiling is ~an order of magnitude larger, so their kill mechanism does not transfer.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified on 18,216 exploration played rows: ftm corr with pts +0.6595, fouls_drawn +0.6749, fta +0.6548. fouls_drawn/fta/ftm 100% covered all six seasons. fta==0 on 46.4% of rows and fouls_drawn==0 on 30.5% - a HURDLE process, not a rate.
entries.provenance_note: master_player has a manifest. Shotchart-derived rim-share inputs do not - resolve on values per D087.
entries.trap_check: T7 ceiling computed and stated. T3: all regressors are shift-expanding, so cyclic null only. T4: score against the full Q3 ladder. T2: player-level null. Plus D093's cancellation check - component gains that cancel in the product must not be reported as points gains.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: FT is 17.37% of points. Perfect-ftm bound R2 0.4350; fouls_drawn bound 0.4555. Realistic target ~0.002-0.005 dR2 - well clear of the 0.001 bar.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D084 ruling 2 explicitly lists 'zone mix feeding foul-draw and free-throw rates' as UNTESTED. D085 killed foul-draw MATCHUP (opponent interaction, REDUNDANT as a repackaged main effect) - a different claim from the player's own foul-draw/FT process being unforecastable.

entries.statement: Injury TYPE conditions the return hazard - why p_active mis-shapes long absences
entries.mechanism: Return timelines differ enormously by injury (ACL=season, concussion protocol=days, illness=a game). p_active uses a single duration curve, which is exactly the observed signature: 11.5pp too pessimistic and MIS-SHAPED rather than uniformly biased.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: injury_history.csv: 8340 rows 2021-01-07..2026-07-29; 2242 missed_game_injury with 184 distinct body-part notes (KNEE INJURY 179, RIGHT KNEE 152, CONCUSSION PROTOCOL 57, ACL 53, ACHILLES 36, ILLNESS 42); 3131 missed_game_other; 3262 missed-game rows in 2021-2024; 356 distinct players. Corroborated by master_player.dnp_reason (100% populated on all 5384 DNP rows, 22 values).
entries.provenance_note: NO MANIFEST on injury_history.csv - resolve on values (D087 method) and record it.
entries.trap_check: T1: use only spells that CLOSED before the forecast date - enforce, do not assert. T5: parse injury type from note VALUES; freeze and hash the taxonomy before screening. T4: Q3 ladder.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Bounded by the measured 11.5pp defect on the long-absence stratum; error is large and one-directional.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D090 ruled p_active should not be rebuilt but named the long-absence curve as THE one actionable defect and recommended a targeted recalibration. Injury type is the obvious missing conditioner and was never joined.

entries.statement: Recover part of the same-day-news fraction of the volume channel from PRIOR absence spells
entries.mechanism: A teammate who has missed the last four games with an ACL is overwhelmingly likely to be out tonight, and that inference is STRICTLY PRIOR. The unavailable part is genuinely same-day (a shootaround scratch); the persistent part is not.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: injury_history.csv + master_player.dnp_reason. Verified: 78.5% of the 2990 team-games have >=1 DNP, 56.1% >=2, 30.8% >=3, mean 1.80 DNPs per team-game.
entries.provenance_note: No manifest on injury_history.csv; resolve on values.
entries.trap_check: T1: only spells closed strictly before game date. T2: null at team-game level. T4: measure as an increment over the PRIOR-ONLY variant, which is the honest incumbent.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Tip-time variant 0.0078 vs prior-only 0.0023; the gap is 0.0055 and this targets a fraction of it. Even a third would exceed every other lead in the program.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D089 r3 frames the whole gap as an ACQUISITION question. It is partly acquisition and partly CONSTRUCTION, and the construction half has never been attempted.

entries.statement: Test whether the cold-start rule and the teammate-volume lead are additive
entries.mechanism: Both act on the same rows, so their gains may not be additive - promoting both to E2 on a summed expectation would overstate the package.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only. Frames exist: E1_I0018/screen_frame.parquet and E1_I0020/tier_frame.parquet.
entries.trap_check: T4: one shared reference for both. T8: skill, not MAE.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Bounded by the smaller of the two gains; the question is whether 0.0023 + cold-start overstates the joint gain.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Directed explicitly by D089 ruling 4 and never dispatched.
entries.extends_live_lead: D089 volume channel + D092 cold-start tiering

entries.statement: Re-audit every shift-expanding screen under the cyclic-shift null
entries.mechanism: SCHEME_WITHIN is anticonservative for autocorrelated regressors (p 0.0015 vs honest 0.39), and the program's most common construction is .shift(1).expanding(), which is autocorrelated by design.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: All frozen screen dirs readable; permutation draws stored (permutation_draws.npz, maxt_null_draws.csv).
entries.trap_check: T3 is the subject. T6: verify the cyclic null can fire, using D093's iid noise controls.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Creates no lead; protects every surviving one and could withdraw one.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D093 ruling 4 states this should be CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED, specifically for surviving leads. Undone.

entries.statement: master_player.position is blank on every non-starter - re-test position from player_bios
entries.mechanism: A feature keyed on a column that is missing for 55.65% of rows silently conditions on starter status, which is itself outcome-adjacent. A null measured that way is uninformative.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified on VALUES: position non-blank on exactly 14,950 rows = exactly starter_flag==1; perfect separation. player_bios.position_raw is 99.81% covered across 1058 player-seasons (Guard 482, Forward 305, Center 122, +147 hyphenated). master_player joins to bios on (player_id, season) at 100%.
entries.trap_check: T5: nominated by name, CONVICTED ON VALUES via cross-tab - a re-test must do the same. T6: the blank-position case is a live example of a control that cannot fail.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Restores an axis D092 discarded; bounded by whatever the cold-start rule's position term would have been worth.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D092 dropped listed position on p 0.783 / permutation null 0.1996. FIRST STEP is a five-minute check of WHICH COLUMN D092 read; if it read bios, this entry collapses to a cut.

entries.statement: Apply D073's level-vs-updating decomposition to every live lead
entries.mechanism: D073's technique: when a market comparison is blocked by missing prices, ask which COMPONENT of the feature a posted line must already contain and test whether the effect lives there. It killed the possession-volume family by showing ~99% sat in the team-season pace LEVEL and ~0% in within-season updating.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only on existing frames; needs no market data - that is the point of the technique.
entries.trap_check: T4: this IS a reference-completeness test in disguise.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Could kill the teammate-volume lead the same way it killed I0013 - worth knowing before it consumes holdout at E2.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D073 ruling 3 generalised the technique explicitly ('GENERALISE THIS') and nobody carried it forward to the live leads.

entries.statement: Decompose the one forecast that works - where does MINUTES skill live?
entries.mechanism: The program spent ~1000 cells on the target where skill is absent (efficiency) and nothing on understanding the target where skill is present (+3.55%, roughly doubling under abstention).
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: minutes 100% on played rows; starter_flag 100%; derived/stints.parquet gives 121,629 per-player per-period stints with stint_sec and player_game_sec.
entries.trap_check: T4: decompose against the Q3 ladder. T2: player-level null.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Not a new lead - the map of the only thing that works, and it tells every future proposal what a working signal looks like here.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never attempted. D081 decomposed POINTS to find where skill is lost; the mirror question about minutes was never asked.

entries.statement: Size the void-risk under-estimate as an expected-value quantity
entries.mechanism: D090 r3 calls it the most directly monetisable finding of the session and notes it needs no new signal and no new data - only using the observed rate rather than the predicted one in the 0.50-0.80 band.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: E0_I0019_availability_forecast/void_risk_bands.csv already exists.
entries.trap_check: T8: this is a CALIBRATION claim, not a skill claim, and must be labelled as such.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Already measured; this converts it into a decision quantity. 7.7pp under-estimate on 9.5% of rows in the costly direction.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Surfaced for the user at D090 and never quantified in decision terms. The model change is a user decision; the sizing is not.

entries.statement: Overtime inflates the target on 4.2% of rows and is unforecastable at tip-off
entries.mechanism: No pre-game information predicts overtime, so the model is charged for structurally unforecastable variance.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: 66 of 1495 games reach period>=5. Player-rows in OT games: mean minutes 21.068 vs 25.147 (+19.4%); mean points 8.652 vs 10.224 (+18.2%); 1197 rows = 4.23% of played rows.
entries.trap_check: T7: compute the variance removed BEFORE believing the idea. T1: OT status is post-game - may define an evaluation stratum, never a feature.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Small: removing 4.2% of rows carrying ~19% inflation. May fall below the Q4 detection floor - that is the honest risk.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D021 recorded an OT-handling divergence (A12/A16/A26) as a preserved disagreement at TEAM level; never examined at player level.

entries.statement: Excise garbage-time POSSESSIONS from the response - not D093's minutes floor
entries.mechanism: A realised-minutes floor drops whole ROWS on total minutes. A garbage-time filter removes the POSSESSIONS played at a large margin while keeping the row. possessions.parquet carries home_pts_before/away_pts_before per possession, so margin-by-time is exact.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: 7.02% of all possessions and 14.88% of period>=4 possessions run at |margin|>=20; 15.63% at >=15. Full 1495-game coverage.
entries.provenance_note: possessions.parquet has NO manifest and its coverage exceeds raw pbp - Q30 gates this.
entries.trap_check: T1: margin is a within-game retrospective fact - legitimate for defining an evaluation response, NEVER as a feature. T3: the resulting response is still autocorrelated.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: D093 found the minutes floor removes 39.3% of ppm variance and 44.7% of the within-player component - the noise is real and large; the question is whether a sharper instrument reaches it.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D093 closed the MINUTES-FLOOR construction on a strongest-reference comparison. It did not test possession-level excision, and its finding that the noise was already priced into the reference is a statement about that construction.

entries.statement: Every count target is over-dispersed and zero-inflated - OLS is an unexamined choice
entries.mechanism: The whole program measures dR2 under a Gaussian/OLS convention nobody justified against the response's actual distribution.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified variance/mean on the exploration partition: reb 2.93, ast 2.40, oreb 1.74 (53.0% zeros), blk 1.51 (70.9% zeros), fg3m 1.79 (56.6% zeros), ftm 2.87 (49.3% zeros), tov 1.39, pts 6.45. Poisson would give 1.0.
entries.trap_check: T7: the ceiling is a RE-RANKING, not new signal. T4: hold the reference fixed while varying only the link.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Creates no signal; may reveal that a kill was a link artefact. Bounded and honest about it.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D069 adopted a metric convention; it never asked whether the response's scale suits it. This is squarely 'which target is measured on the wrong scale'.

entries.statement: The champion cannot score 15.97% of its own universe - what happens to those rows?
entries.mechanism: master_player carries a row for every rostered player including DNPs. The response is observed CONDITIONALLY ON SELECTION. If those rows are silently dropped, every coverage and skill figure is computed on a survivor population.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: 5384 of 33712 rows (15.97%) have null minutes; dnp_reason populated on 100% of them and 0% of played rows.
entries.trap_check: T1: dnp_reason is post-game - may define a stratum, never a feature. T6: 'we drop DNP rows' is exactly a step that cannot fail and is never reported.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: This is D010's 'flattered by construction' finding one level down and 15.97% wide.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never examined. D090 characterised p_active as a FORECAST; this asks how the EVALUATION UNIVERSE is constructed.

entries.statement: Abstention has only ever been measured one variable at a time
entries.mechanism: The decision a bettor faces is joint - 'given everything observable pre-game, is my skill here positive?' - not 'is depth low?'.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only on existing scored frames (E0_I0015, E0_I0019).
entries.trap_check: T8: response must be SKILL against a reference facing the same rows - the failure D076 demonstrated twice. T2: null at the level the rule operates. T6: include a random-abstention control that CAN fail (D092 built one: negative_control_random_tier.csv).
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: D076's best single rule roughly DOUBLES minutes skill at ~60% coverage. A joint surface can only match or beat it; the interesting number is by how much.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D090 ruled against ONE SPECIFIC COMBINATION (p_active + depth) on evidence. That is not a ruling against joint conditioning generally.

entries.statement: Audit every control in every screen for whether it CAN fail
entries.mechanism: The natural per-player control is a literal no-op (observed sd 5.207e-17) that returns a clean bill of health while testing nothing.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: All frozen screens readable; several ship noop_placebo_draws.csv explicitly.
entries.trap_check: T6 is the subject. Also check D093's failure mode where precision weights were the one player-attached quantity a covariate permutation does not permute (NC1 passed at p 0.0076 weighted, p 0.194 unweighted).
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Protects the ledger; could withdraw an assurance rather than a result.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D093 found ONE instance and named the class. The sweep was never run.

entries.statement: Nothing accounts for multiplicity ACROSS screens
entries.mechanism: Each screen corrects family-wise WITHIN itself. ~1000 cells have been fired program-wide with no program-level accounting.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Screen results stored as screen_results.csv in several directories.
entries.trap_check: T4 interacts: cells scored against different references are not exchangeable, so a naive pooled FDR would itself be wrong. Must be handled, not ignored.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Changes the interpretation of every thin survivor (e.g. D074's conversion channel, which survived family-wise correction 'thinly').
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never attempted.

entries.statement: Does the player model beat 'team total x prior usage share'?
entries.mechanism: A top-down reference: forecast team points, allocate by strictly-prior usage share. If the champion cannot beat that, the player layer is questionable; if it can, the margin IS the player layer's contribution.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: master_team.parquet (2990 rows, full opp_* columns); usage_percentage and estimated_usage_percentage 100% covered on played rows.
entries.trap_check: T4: this IS a reference-completeness probe and belongs on the Q3 ladder. T1: usage share must be strictly prior.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Adds no signal; bounds the player layer's value and may reveal the champion's skill is inherited from the team model.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D061 records layer 4 (bottom-up aggregation) as VIABLE_BUT_UNVALIDATED with a guard against rebuilding it. This is the REFERENCE question, not the aggregation rebuild, so the P3 guard does not bind.

entries.statement: Possession-level DEFENDER IDENTITY, not team-aggregate defensive rating
entries.mechanism: D085's 12 constructions were all built from TEAM-LEVEL AGGREGATES. possessions.parquet carries def_p1..def_p5 on every one of 238,563 possessions, so actual defender identity is available.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: shots join to possessions on 100% of shots_2023_regular GAME_IDs; 5515 of 5515 shots (100%) fall inside a possession window on a 40-game sample under the cumulative-game-seconds convention; 46% are boundary-ambiguous and need tie-breaking by offense_team_id. 2026 shots match 100%, so this IS confirmable at E2 unlike anything on raw pbp.
entries.provenance_note: Neither possessions.parquet nor data/shotcharts/* has a manifest. Q30 gates this.
entries.trap_check: T4: score against the Q3 ladder - D085's kill mechanism was aggregation, but reference weakness is the more likely reason a re-run would APPEAR to succeed. T7: state the ceiling BEFORE screening; the honest prior is small. T2: null at matchup level, not row.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: The efficiency surface is closed at dR2 ~0. Must clear the Q4 detection floor to be worth anything, and a proposer should expect it not to.
entries.why_not_already_dead: MOST LIKELY ENTRY IN THE QUEUE TO BE A RE-PROPOSAL OF DEAD GROUND, and queued with that stated. Survives only because the kill mechanism was aggregation and the construction is genuinely different. DO NOT DISPATCH BEFORE Q4 AND Q30.

entries.statement: Rebound opportunity is downstream of shot location, and no rebound forecast exists
entries.mechanism: Where shots come from determines where misses land. D087 r3 names this as 'the honest next frontier'.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: data/shotcharts/ covers all six seasons (26k-38k shots/season) with SHOT_ZONE_BASIC (7 zones), SHOT_DISTANCE, LOC_X/LOC_Y; oreb/dreb 100% covered.
entries.provenance_note: shotcharts have NO manifest; D087 resolved this gate on values and that method should be reused.
entries.trap_check: T7 ceiling stated against the right target. T16/Q16: zero-inflation makes the link choice load-bearing.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Real but must be stated against the REBOUND target, not points: oreb perfect-forecast bound on POINTS is only 0.0763. reb var 10.75 (14.6% zeros); oreb var 1.51 (53.0% zeros).
entries.why_not_already_dead: GATED: D088 r1 settled that generating a rebound forecast requires generating forecasts and no coordinator work can discharge it.

entries.statement: Points decompose into four channels at player level and none has been used
entries.mechanism: points_paint, points_fast_break, points_second_chance, points_off_turnovers are four distinct generating processes summed into one target.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified 100% coverage in all six seasons for all four channels plus their four opp_* mirrors.
entries.trap_check: T7: ceiling is the sum of the channels' forecastable variance. T4: Q3 ladder. Report component-vs-product explicitly.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Unknown; must be computed per channel before screening. D093's cancellation finding is the specific risk (FGA/min +1.055% and pts/FGA +0.826% gave a product of only +0.443%).
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never screened. Distinct from shot LOCATION (D079, killed on points) - points_fast_break is a transition-CONTEXT channel. Note pace/transition are closed (D085) as OPPONENT/context features; this is the player's own channel mix.

entries.statement: Starter/bench is a regime switch and the champion may be averaging across it
entries.mechanism: A model emitting a conditional mean across a bimodal mixture produces a value wrong for both regimes.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: starter_flag 100% populated, splits 14,950 / 18,762.
entries.trap_check: T1: TONIGHT's starter flag is post-lineup and may not be a feature; PRIOR-GAME starter status may. This distinction is the whole proposal. T8: skill, not MAE.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Bounded by the size of the regime-transition population - players changing role - which must be counted first.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Related to but distinct from the killed 'starting-five stability' (D076), which was a TEAM churn variable. This is the player's own regime.

entries.statement: Replace cross-screen dR2 with a common-currency metric
entries.mechanism: dR2 depends on the response's variance decomposition and the weighting, so a cross-screen ordering is fragile even after a convention is imposed.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only.
entries.trap_check: T4 and T7 both bear on it.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Changes which lead is 'best' and therefore what gets promoted to E2.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D072 ruling 4 identified this and recommended comparing on a common target; no common currency was ever defined, so the program still ranks by dR2.

entries.statement: Establish the irreducible-noise floor of the minutes forecast from realised game margin
entries.mechanism: Minutes depend on game script (blowouts truncate starters, inflate bench), and game script is unforecastable at tip-off.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: possessions.parquet margin-by-time on all 1495 games; minutes 100% on played rows. Verified 7.02% of possessions at |margin|>=20.
entries.trap_check: T1: realised margin defines an evaluation stratum, NEVER a feature. T8: skill against a reference facing the same rows.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Bounds the only target with skill - tells the program how much of the remaining minutes error is even addressable.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never attempted.

entries.statement: Age and career stage as a prior, especially where history is thin
entries.mechanism: Aging curves are among the most robust effects in team sports. Age is constant within a season so it cannot help within-player, but it is exactly the prior that helps where the model currently emits a constant.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: player_bios.csv: age 98.2%, birthdate 100%, draft_year/draft_number 86.1%. Joins to master_player at 100% on (player_id, season).
entries.trap_check: T1: age is fixed pre-season - a clean Tier-1 provenance case under D065. T2: null at player-SEASON level; a row-level null here is the classic wrong-null error.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Small on the pooled panel; potentially material on the 1115 rows with <=2 prior appearances (3.94%), which is D092's validated target population.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D092 validated draft slot and depth-chart rank and dropped listed position. Age was not in that candidate set.

entries.statement: Walk-forward RAPM artifacts exist, carry manifests, and may be unused
entries.mechanism: A walk-forward RAPM is a per-player quality estimate built to be point-in-time valid - exactly the kind of prior the cold-start and reference work needs.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: data/rapm/ holds rapm_v0.csv, rapm_walkforward.csv, rapm_walkforward_seasons.csv - ALL THREE WITH SIBLING MANIFESTS, among the few gate-passing artifacts in the repository.
entries.provenance_note: 3 of 6 files carry manifests - unusually good provenance for this repo.
entries.trap_check: T5: 'walkforward' in a filename is a NOMINATION, not a conviction - verify the construction on values. T1: verify no future rows enter the fit.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: If valid and unused, a free player-quality prior; if used, this closes in an hour.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never referenced anywhere in D001-D093. First step is determining whether anything consumes it.

entries.statement: Resolve the provenance of possessions.parquet - it gates several entries
entries.mechanism: An artifact cannot straightforwardly have more coverage than its apparent source.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: possessions.parquet covers all 1495 games including 215 in 2026, but data/playbyplay/ holds only 996 files and ZERO for 2026 (2021 192/209, 2022 216/239, 2023 240/260, 2024 240/262, 2025 108/310, 2026 0/215).
entries.trap_check: T1: if part was built retrospectively from a season-complete source it is a retrospective-baseline hazard exactly like data/lineups/. T5: resolve on values.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Gates Q15, Q22, Q23, Q27, Q41.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D080 verified two OTHER high-priority artifacts as ROW-granular and clean; possessions.parquet was not among them. D075/D080 rank the manifest backlog as the highest-value infrastructure work available, and D085/D090 record two occasions where the gap BLOCKED SCIENCE.

entries.statement: Cumulative season LOAD is a different mechanism from schedule STATE
entries.mechanism: Rest days, B2B and 3-in-4 are properties of the CALENDAR. Cumulative minutes played to date is accumulated EXPOSURE - a property of the player's season - and was in none of those screens.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: minutes 100% on played rows; trivially cumulative.
entries.trap_check: T3: a cumulative sum is MAXIMALLY autocorrelated - only a cyclic-shift null is admissible. This is the single most T3-exposed candidate in the queue. T4: it correlates mechanically with games played, so the reference must already contain prior-appearance depth or the 'signal' is just depth.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Modest; and the honest prior after four schedule kills is low.
entries.why_not_already_dead: QUEUED WITH AN EXPLICIT WARNING: it sits next to a family closed with a 'no fifth attempt without a new mechanism' requirement (D090 r5). The new-mechanism argument above is the whole justification and a coordinator may reasonably reject it.

entries.statement: Is the minutes forecast E[minutes] or E[minutes | active]?
entries.mechanism: If the champion forecasts minutes conditional on playing, multiplying by a per-minute rate gives E[points | active], not E[points]. Combining with p_active requires knowing which quantity each component is.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only; p_active exists in both arms (D088).
entries.trap_check: T6: 'we assume the model forecasts the conditional mean' is an assumption that cannot fail unless tested against emitted values.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Not a signal; a correctness question whose answer changes how every downstream product is formed.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D090 ruled p_active adds nothing TO ABSTENTION. Different question from whether the minutes and availability forecasts COMPOSE correctly.

entries.statement: Gate every candidate on HOLDOUT CONSTRUCTIBILITY before screening it
entries.mechanism: A lead built on raw pbp can be discovered and can NEVER be confirmed.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: raw pbp covers 888/970 exploration games (91.5%) but 108/525 holdout games (20.6%) and 0/215 in 2026. possessions.parquet (all 1495 games) and data/shotcharts/ (all six seasons) do NOT have this gap, so the constraint is source-specific and checkable.
entries.trap_check: T4: reference-incompleteness in the TIME dimension.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Prevents spending an entire screen on something unconfirmable.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Not recorded anywhere. Should become a standing line in every screen's feasibility section alongside the manifest gate.

entries.statement: Model free throws as a HURDLE, not a rate
entries.mechanism: An EWMA of 'FT rate' over a series that is zero half the time estimates a quantity that does not exist for half the sample.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Verified: fta==0 on 46.4% of played rows; fouls_drawn==0 on 30.5%; ftm variance/mean 2.87 with 49.3% zeros. 100% covered all seasons.
entries.trap_check: T7: carries Q5's ceiling. T2/T3: player-level cyclic null.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Sub-component of Q5's ceiling; queued separately because the hurdle framing is the part most likely to be skipped.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Never screened (see Q5). Kept distinct from Q5 so a screener taking Q5 cannot quietly implement a continuous rate.

entries.statement: The program has never looked at the error DISTRIBUTION, only its centre
entries.mechanism: A bettor is exposed to the tail, not the mean. For the continuous targets nobody has characterised the residual's tails, skew or heteroskedasticity.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Scored frames exist (E0_I0015/decomp_frame.parquet, E0_I0019/scored_frame.parquet).
entries.trap_check: T8: a distributional improvement is NOT a skill improvement and must not be reported as one - this is the entry's main risk.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Does not raise dR2; changes what the forecast can be used for.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D057 demoted global MAE in favour of conditional edge plus abstention and D090 decomposed p_active's error into discrimination vs calibration; the distributional half for continuous targets was never picked up.

entries.statement: Teammate absence TYPE should moderate usage redistribution
entries.mechanism: Usage vacated by a player out with a season-ending ACL redistributes differently from usage vacated by a one-game coach's decision - the first triggers a role change, the second does not.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: dnp_reason: 22 values, 100% populated on all 5384 DNP rows, separating Coach's Decision (2824) from Injury/Illness (1662+464) and Not With Team (152). injury_history.csv gives dated spells with type.
entries.trap_check: T1: THIS IS THE TRAP THAT WOULD KILL THE ENTRY - tonight's dnp_reason is post-game. Strictly-prior use only: the teammate's PRIOR absence spells. T4: measure as an increment over the prior-only volume variant.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: A moderator on a channel whose usable ceiling is 0.0021; realistically a fraction of that.
entries.why_not_already_dead: I0006 ('usage redistribution conditional on teammate composition') was proposed and screened as COMPOSITION; absence TYPE was never a dimension of it.

entries.statement: What does the champion shrink toward, and is that target itself degenerate?
entries.mechanism: Every hierarchical estimator has a shrinkage target. If it is a pooled mean over a population that does not resemble the row being scored, the shrinkage does harm that GROWS as history thins - which is exactly the cold-start signature.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only, plus reading the champion's emitted values.
entries.trap_check: T6: 'the model shrinks toward the league mean' is an assumption; recover it from emitted values.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Directly generalises the finding that produced the program's largest free gain.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D092 found the constant; it did not ask what MECHANISM produces it or where else that mechanism applies. Dispatch with Q2.

entries.statement: Does a lead measured on 2021-2024 hold ACROSS SEASONS WITHIN the partition?
entries.mechanism: Per-season stability is the cheapest available robustness evidence and does not touch the holdout.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: Score-only; 4 seasons of 209/239/260/262 games. Some screens computed it (E1_I0020/per_season_stability.csv, E0_I0019/per_season_metrics.csv); it is not standard.
entries.trap_check: T2: 4 seasons is a small number of clusters and a season-level null has almost no power - report as DESCRIPTIVE, not as a test.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Protects against a lead driven by one season.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Not standard practice; should be.

entries.statement: Foul trouble truncates exposure and is a distinct channel from minutes
entries.mechanism: A player in foul trouble is removed regardless of role or game script - a truncation mechanism separate from both blowout truncation (Q27) and rotation role (Q12).
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: pf and pf_misc 100% covered; possessions.parquet gives the timing to distinguish early from late fouls.
entries.provenance_note: master_player has a manifest; possessions.parquet does not.
entries.trap_check: T1: TONIGHT's fouls are post-game; only the player's prior foul rate and the opponent's prior foul-drawing rate are admissible. T4: prior foul rate correlates with minutes, so the reference must contain prior minutes.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Small; a moderator on the one target with skill.
entries.why_not_already_dead: Not in D076's 348 cells (schedule, churn, unfamiliarity, role volatility) and not in D085's basketball-specific set, which targeted EFFICIENCY not minutes.

entries.statement: Separate 'the coach removed them' from 'that is their role'
entries.mechanism: Two players averaging 20 minutes differ if one plays 20 nightly and the other alternates 32 and 8. The question is WHY the variance occurs: game script and foul trouble (exogenous) versus rotation change (persistent).
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: possessions.parquet margin and stints.parquet give the mechanism; master_player.minutes gives the outcome.
entries.provenance_note: Neither possessions.parquet nor stints.parquet has a manifest.
entries.trap_check: T1: mechanism attribution uses realised within-game facts, so it can define a PRIOR-GAME feature only after the prior game is complete - which is legitimate. T8: D076's failure here was exactly T8 and must not be repeated.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Bounded by the minutes target; the honest prior is low given D076's result.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D076 screened pl_min_sd5 and pl_min_cv5 and found large |t| with NEGATIVE skill gain at every coverage, concluding they are volume proxies. That is a finding about those two CONSTRUCTIONS, not about the underlying distinction. Queued with D076's negative stated up front.

entries.statement: Opponent possession supply may matter for REBOUNDS though it is dead for points and assists
entries.mechanism: Rebound opportunity is more mechanically tied to possession count than any other box quantity: more possessions means more missed shots means more rebound chances.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: master_team.parquet and possessions.parquet; oreb/dreb 100% covered.
entries.trap_check: T4: THE D073 DECOMPOSITION (Q11) MUST BE RUN FIRST - if the effect sits in the team-season pace level it is the same dead thing wearing a rebound label. T7: oreb perfect-forecast bound on points is 0.0763, but the target is rebounds.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Modest, and the D073 precedent is genuinely discouraging.
entries.why_not_already_dead: QUEUED LOW DELIBERATELY. D073 closed the family with 'Do not re-screen it'; the only thing distinguishing this is the target.

entries.statement: Price the acquisition: what would a real pre-game inactives feed be worth?
entries.mechanism: D089 r3 names a pre-game injury/inactives feed as the single highest-value data acquisition the program has identified, and D023 amendment (1) shows the user wants acquisition questions answered with verification rather than assumption.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: The bound already exists in E1_I0018_teammate_volume_channel/tiptime_loss_ladder.csv: tip-time variant 0.0078 vs prior-only 0.0023.
entries.trap_check: T1: the tip-time variant MAY NEVER BE QUOTED AS A RESULT (D089 r2) - it is an upper bound only, and this entry exists precisely to use it as one.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Not a screen; a decision packet. The bound already exists.
entries.why_not_already_dead: ACQUISITION FLAG: (a) a pre-game injury report / inactives feed for 2021-2024; (b) historical odds for 2021-2024, absent per D071/D073 (bookie_totals_per_game.csv has zero in-partition rows; totals_head/game_level_totals.csv has 229 rows dated 2024 with bookie_consensus_total 100% NULL). Run Q7 FIRST - it may recover part of the gap for free and would change what the acquisition is worth.

entries.statement: Does the 2021 opening-day exclusion still flatter every cold-start figure?
entries.mechanism: D010 confirmed the possession universe excludes the four games of 2021-05-14 - the single hardest cold-start day - and ruled every cold-start coverage figure on that universe FLATTERED BY CONSTRUCTION.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: master_player holds 1495 games and possessions.parquet also holds 1495; the 1491-game universe is a DERIVED frame. This entry checks which frame the cold-start screens actually used.
entries.provenance_note: Depends which frame; check on values.
entries.trap_check: T5: settle on values, not on a filename.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Small, but it touches the one rule headed for production.
entries.why_not_already_dead: D010 recorded the consequence and no screen has confirmed which universe it used. The cold-start work (D092) is now the program's most actionable finding.

entries.statement: College and country as a zero-history prior
entries.mechanism: For a player with no WNBA history, college programme and international background are the only signals beyond draft slot.
entries.feasibility_on_bytes: player_bios.csv: college 87.7%, country 99.2%. 100% joinable to master_player.
entries.trap_check: T2: null at player level. T7: THE POPULATION IS 384 ROWS (1.36%) - very close to unable to clear the bar.
entries.arithmetic_ceiling: Very small. D092 already ruled the debut population is 'small, already largely abstained on, and mostly veterans'.
entries.why_not_already_dead: RANKED LAST DELIBERATELY. D092 r3 directs cold-start effort at 1-2 prior appearances rather than debuts, which is precisely where this does NOT apply. Included only because it is cheap and completes the bios surface; a coordinator should feel free to move it to CUT_LIST.md.
